author: Da_Baus
body:
Hello, Avicus Staff Team.
To start things off I feel very bad for doing using kill aura and I would like to apologise from the bottom of my heart because I forgot  how much time of effort you guys put into this server and I wasted it by doing what I did and I am very ashamed.
I feel bad for my team because I was informed that I had to be there for them to be able to compete in the tournament I had informed them about and letting down the whole community because I was a trusted member and did what I did.
I have been longing to play Avicus and hope that you unban me

Sincerely Fraglantia.
